tagline.en_US: A web client for opening SSH or Telnet sessions in a browser. The official image listens on port 8182 without a database or volume; this profile supplies a generated shared key instead of leaving the web interface passwordless.

description.en_US: Sshwifty is a web-based SSH and Telnet client that allows users to access remote command-line services directly inside a web browser. It provides a browser-accessible terminal interface to connect to remote servers without needing a local terminal emulator installed on the client machine. Session data is handled directly within the browser.
